# Action fixtures

Each case folder holds a `case.json` read by `scripts/action-local.mjs`: the fixture layers copied, in order, into the base commit (`base`) and the head commit (`head`), optional `renames` applied to the head (file names a committed file cannot carry: a newline, a terminal escape), an optional `baseRef` (empty means no base commit), `clone: "shallow"` for a one-commit clone over `file://`, `tools: "fake"` to put the fake helm and kustomize of `test/fixtures/fake-tools` first on PATH (the case renders a chart the same way on every machine), and the result it `expect`s. The head commit's parent is the base commit, so the merge base the Action compares with is the base commit itself. Shared layers: `_estate/full` (Argo CD deploys Gitea from a repository Gitea serves, and a web application) and `_estate/web-only` (the web application alone). The repository's own URL in every case is `http://gitea-http.gitea:3000/ops/estate`.
